id.description: Id to assist in generating a React key prop.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

field.description: If used in a form, the field this component is associated with.

hideInput.description: Whether or not to show inputs.

hideMarkers.description: Hide the tic marks on the slider. This will remove the tic marks from the slider display.

hint.description: Descriptive text to aid the user in interacting with this input.

markStep.description:
The value to step by when adding interval marks to the slider.  Steps will be added starting at
min by markStep up to and include min.
Example min = 0; max = 100; markStep = 25 A mark will be located at each point [0 25 50 75 100].
These are the visual tick marks along the bottom of the slider bar and have no functional implications
on the slider.

step.description:
Value to be added or subtracted on each step the slider makes.  Must be greater than zero and max - min should
be evenly divisible by the step value.
This is the interval at which the slider increments and dictates the functional component of the slider.
Example min = 0; max = 100; markStep = 25; step = 5.
The minimum value will be 0.
The maximum value will be 100.
A mark will be located at each point [0 25 50 75 100].
Eligible values for the slider to "land" on will be 0 5 10 ... 100.

max.description: The maximum value for the slider.

maxMarkers.description:
The maximum number of tic marks to show on the slider.  This is used
for automatically generating the markStep size.  This includes a tic
mark for the min and max values.

min.description: The minimum value for the slider.

value.description: The initial value for the slider.
